note: The session's web search allowance was already used up, so nobody in this part could be searched for by name; only pages whose address was known or could be reached from a known page were read (court, city and school district pages, the Michigan House's member list, the parties' own endorsement pages, campaign sites linked from Wikipedia's 2026 election articles). Not reached: the Department of Education's State Board pages and the Governor's releases (the state's site refuses scripts), Grand Rapids Public Schools (certificate error), Harper Woods' court page (no lookup), Matt Koleszar's campaign site (it answered with a server error twice, so it is not recorded). Looked at and nothing recorded: Saginaw's council page does not list Jeanette Barnett; the board pages of Goodrich, Oakridge, Southfield, Detroit and Grosse Pointe do not list Courtney Berry, Roger Lee Taylor, Amani Johnson, Darious Morris or Mariel Krupansky; Grandville's own 2026 candidates page lists Emily Berlin but states no office; Wyandotte's board page lists a trustee 'Carrie Martinez', which may or may not be Carolyn Martinez, so nothing is recorded; Kalamazoo County's and Clinton County's court pages did not name Tiffany A. Ankley or Shannon L.W. Schlegel on the pages reached; the Kalamazoo, Kent, Ottawa and Eaton county Democratic pages showed none of this part's names. Matt Koleszar's and Mai Xiong's birth dates on Wikipedia carry no citation and are left out. A blank means not looked up or not found, not that nothing exists.
